name: Single-Day Reports / Explicit Comparisons
notes: Frontend-only Reports refinement. Reports now use one selected report date. The selected day, previous day and same weekday last week are requested as three exact one-day reportsSnapshot reads instead of one expanded multi-day window. Comparison panels are explicitly labelled as comparisons. Export is restricted to the selected day and is disabled until that selected day has loaded. Report refresh is latest-date-wins: a date selected while another report refresh is in flight is queued and loaded next rather than discarded. Existing compatible Apps Script backends 3.13.16, 3.13.17 and 3.13.18 remain supported; included Code.gs remains 3.13.18 and is unchanged. Database remains 1.0.6.
